rows.interpretation: Body evidence combines separate FlyBody output and reduced-scenario telemetry; it does not demonstrate neural or niche feedback.
Brain evidence separates source registries from parsed local anatomy/activity payloads and declares availability gates when public data are absent.
Mind methods are transparent and deterministic, with calibration left as a known gap.
Swarm evidence separates strict small-scene physics from reduced colony dynamics.
Niche methods include deterministic seasonal/weather witnesses, not a full ecology engine.

title: Methods detail: module evidence and explicit boundaries
